author: maalroth
quote:
I remember going from GTA 3 to Vice City and finally being able to fly a plane (or a car) feeling like now you could do literally anything you could think of. More important than the story or characters, the game was there as a playground for you to do as you please and every game has been in service of that experience since. GTA 6 fps feels like I'm being patronized and condescended to by a bunch of Pu****** on a writing/development team that want to tell me what I can and can't do, and think I need to pay $100 for private boyfriend lessons in my video game. 

 What are we doing?
